articles.title: Hackers Use Stolen Microsoft Entra ID and Azure DevOps Credentials to Access 27 Organizations
articles.summary:
Hackers are abusing stolen Microsoft Entra ID application credentials and Azure DevOps identities to access Microsoft 365 and Azure environments, reaching at least 27 organizations. Todyl’s latest investigation update describes an ongoing campaign targeting managed service providers (MSPs) and their customers since November 1, 2026. articles.title: Hackers Use OpenAI Codex Jailbreak Toolkit That Secretly Injects Ads Into AI Responses
articles.summary:
A jailbreak toolkit targeting OpenAI Codex is doing more than trying to bypass AI safety rules. The Chinese-language package, called Haiou, changes the coding agent’s trusted instructions so that ordinary greetings trigger advertisements for a third-party AI gateway. Researchers describe the behavior as prompt adware because it persists through written instructions rather than a conventional […]
